name: Test field
description: A made-up field used by the tests: two invented products and one decision.

advisorRoles.name: Field liaison
advisorRoles.description: Explains the field's products to the players.

decisionForms.label: Issue a bulletin
decisionForms.description: Publish a bulletin for the harbor.

glossary.definition: A short notice with a level, an area and an expiry time.

productConventions: A bulletin names its level first, then the area, then the expiry time.
realismRules: A warning is never issued without an area.
Times are written in the local zone.
